solutions.title: Fixed bit scan
solutions.strategy: Inspect each of the 32 bit positions and add the low bit before shifting.

timeComplexity.explanation: Exactly 32 positions are inspected for a fixed-width integer.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the running count and shifted value are stored.

solutions.title: Clear lowest set bit
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly remove the lowest set bit, counting only the one bits that actually exist.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most 32 set bits can be removed from a fixed-width integer.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The method stores only the count and current word.
